subject: Architecture review request: autonomous trigger proposal
body: FA — GP has drafted an autonomous trigger proposal (docs/agents/gp-autonomous-trigger-proposal.md). It outlines 3 options for scheduled GP health checks: GitHub Actions, Task Scheduler, or manual ritual. Before pitching to Marcus I want FA eyes on the design. Main question: is a YAML workflow that runs read-only health scripts safe for this repo, or does it introduce CI risk? The draft recommends starting with manual ritual. Your thoughts appreciated. — GP
